an4.179:1.1: Atha kho āyasma Ānando yen' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi . . .
an4.179:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca :
an4.179:1.3: Ko nu kho āvuso Sāriputta hetu ko paccayo yenam idh' ekacce sattā diṭṭh' eva dhamme na parinibbāyantīti?
an4.179:2.1: Idh' āvuso Ānanda sattā imā hānabhāgiyā saññā ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti, imā ṭhitibhāgiyā saññā ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti, imā visesabhāgiyā saññā ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti, imā nibbedhabhāgiyā saññā ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti.
an4.179:2.2: Ayaṃ kho āvuso Ānanda hetu ayaṃ paccayo yenam idh' ekacce sattā diṭṭh' eva dhamme na parinibbāyantīti. 2.
an4.179:3.1: Ko pan' āvuso Sāriputta hetu ko paccayo yenam idh' ekacce sattā diṭṭh' eva dhamme parinibbāyantīti?
an4.179:3.2: Idh' āvuso Ānanda sattā imā hānabhāgiyā saññā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti, imā ṭhitibhāgiyā saññā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti, imā visesabhāgiyā saññā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti, imā nibbedhabhāgiyā saññā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti.
an4.179:3.3: Ayaṃ kho āvuso Ānanda hetu ayaṃ paccayo yenam idh' ekacce sattā diṭṭh' eva dhamme parinibbāyantīti. 180. 1.
